## Comprehensive Exploration Report: Card Cloning in M@S Studio

I've thoroughly explored the codebase and identified all the key components related to card cloning and Fragment Title management. Here's what I found:

---

## 1. CARD CLONE LOGIC

### Clone Entry Point
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-side-nav.js`
  - **Line 294-297**: `duplicateFragment()` method triggers clone workflow
  - Calls `fragmentEditor.showClone()`

### Clone Dialog UI
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
  - **Lines 1088-1095**: `showClone()` - Opens the clone confirmation dialog
  - **Lines 1105-1121**: `confirmClone()` - Executes the actual clone operation
  - **Lines 1123-1128**: `cancelClone()` - Cleans up state
  - **Line 1033-1034**: `updateCloneFragmentInternal()` - Updates titleClone property
  - **Lines 1233-1281**: Clone dialog rendering with fragment title input field

### Clone Execution Path
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-repository.js`
  - **Lines 1012-1058**: `copyFragment(updatedTitle, osi, tags)` - Main clone operation
    - Calls `this.aem.sites.cf.fragments.copy()` (AEM classic copy API)
    - Updates title if provided
    - Updates OSI field if provided
    - Handles tag copying
    - Adds cloned fragment to cache and store
    - Navigates to new fragment editor

### Low-Level Clone Implementation
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/aem.js`
  - **Lines 350-388**: `copyFragmentClassic(fragment)` - AEM classic API copy
    - Uses AEM's WCM command endpoint: `wcmcommandUrl`
    - Copies to same parent folder (same locale/folder structure)
    - Automatically clears variations field on copy
    - Returns the copied fragment path from AEM response

---

## 2. FRAGMENT TITLE MANAGEMENT

### Where Fragment Title is Set

**During Fragment Creation:**
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-create-dialog.js`
  - **Lines 96-97**: `title` property initialized as empty string
  - **Lines 138-146**: `normalizeFragmentName(str)` - Converts title to fragment name (lowercase, hyphens, removes special chars)
  - **Lines 148-150**: `handleTitleChange(value)` - Updates title from input
  - **Lines 218-222**: Fragment creation payload with title and name
  - **Lines 231-236**: Retry loop with suffix generation if name conflicts

**During Clone:**
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
  - **Line 423**: `titleClone = ''` property for clone dialog
  - **Line 1251**: Default title in clone dialog is copied from current fragment: `value="${this.fragment.title}"`
  - **Line 1114**: Title passed to `repository.copyFragment(this.titleClone, ...)`

**Low-Level Title Handling:**
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/aem.js`
  - **Lines 394-434**: `createFragment(fragment)` - Creates fragment with title
    - Requires: `parentPath`, `title`, `modelId`, `name`
    - All fields sent as JSON to AEM CF API
  - **Lines 682-710**: `createFragmentCopy(fullFragment, targetPath, name, csrfToken)`
    - Copies title from source: `title: fullFragment.title`
    - Allows custom name parameter

---

## 3. DATA MODEL FOR FRAGMENT TITLE AND TAG PATH

### Fragment Class
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/fragment.js`
  - **Line 3**: Fragment class definition
  - **Lines 4-12**: Core properties:
    - `path` - Full AEM path to fragment
    - `id` - Fragment UUID
    - `title` - Display title (stored in AEM as fragment title metadata)
    - `name` - Fragment name (last part of path)
    - `fields` - Array of field objects
    - `tags` - Array of tag objects
    - `model` - Object with `id` and `path`
    - `status` - Draft/Published status
    - `etag` - For optimistic locking

### Tag Data Structure
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/aem-tag-picker-field.js`
  - **Lines 15-29**: `fromAttribute()` converts tag format:
    - Format: `"mas:product/photoshop"` (attribute)
    - To: `"/content/cq:tags/mas/product/photoshop"` (path)
  - **Lines 35-46**: `toAttribute()` converts back
  - Tags stored with both `id` (e.g., `"mas:product/photoshop"`) and `path` (full AEM path)

### Fragment Creation Payload Structure
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-create-dialog.js`
  - **Lines 218-228**:
    ```javascript
    const fragmentData = {
        modelId,           // Tag ID mapping to content model
        title: this.title, // Display title
        name: normalizeFragmentName(this.title), // URL-safe name
        data: {            // Optional data for merch-card
            osi: this.osi,
            tags: this.tags
        }
    }
    ```

---

## 4. UNIQUENESS AND VALIDATION CHECKS

### Fragment Name Deduplication
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/aem.js`
  - **Lines 647-672**: `generateUniqueName(basePath, assetName)` method
    - Checks if name already exists in target folder
    - Appends numeric suffix if conflict: `base-1`, `base-2`, etc.
    - Respects file extensions if present
    - Max 100 attempts before throwing error

### Creation Retry Logic with Suffix
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-create-dialog.js`
  - **Lines 186-195**: `getSuffix(offset)` - Generates random alphanumeric suffix
  - **Lines 231-236**: Retry loop when fragment creation fails:
    - Tries with original name first
    - On failure, appends random suffix: `name-abc123`
    - Retries up to 10 times

### Grouped Variation Name Deduplication
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-repository.js`
  - **Lines 1556-1562**: Creates grouped variation with name conflict handling
    - Generates 4-character random suffix if name exists
    - Format: `fragmentName-abcd`

### Title Validation During Clone
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
  - **Lines 1105-1110**: `confirmClone()` validation:
    - For merch-card model: requires either OSI or existing OSI
    - Title is optional (can use existing title)
    - No explicit title uniqueness check (relies on fragment name uniqueness)

### Tag Path Structure
- Tags use full path format: `/content/cq:tags/namespace/category/value`
- Example: `/content/cq:tags/mas/product/photoshop`
- Can be converted to attribute format: `mas:product/photoshop`
- No built-in uniqueness validation at the tag picker level
- **File**: `/Users/rivero/ai/agentic-experience/apps/mas/trees/cb6ce6e2/studio/src/aem/mas-filter-panel.js`
  - **Lines 93-109**: Converts tag paths to tag IDs and filters

---

## 5. KEY FILE PATHS SUMMARY

| Functionality | File Path | Key Lines |
|---|---|---|
| Clone Dialog Entry | `studio/src/mas-side-nav.js` | 294-297 |
| Clone Dialog UI | `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js` | 1233-1281 |
| Clone Execution | `studio/src/mas-repository.js` | 1012-1058 |
| Low-Level Clone | `studio/src/aem/aem.js` | 350-388 |
| Fragment Title Input | `studio/src/mas-create-dialog.js` | 267-274 |
| Name Normalization | `studio/src/mas-create-dialog.js` | 138-146 |
| Unique Name Generation | `studio/src/aem/aem.js` | 647-672 |
| Fragment Data Model | `studio/src/aem/fragment.js` | 1-87 |
| Tag Path Conversion | `studio/src/aem/aem-tag-picker-field.js` | 15-46 |
| Constants & Model IDs | `studio/src/constants.js` | 148-153 |

---

## 6. EXISTING VALIDATION LOGIC

1. **Fragment Name Uniqueness**: Enforced by `generateUniqueName()` with numeric suffix fallback
2. **Retry Mechanism**: Random suffix generation (10 retries) in create dialog
3. **OSI Requirement**: Clone dialog validates OSI or existing OSI for merch-card model
4. **Tag Validation**: Tags passed through AEM tag picker field with namespace validation
5. **Fragment Title**: No explicit uniqueness check; relies on name uniqueness
6. **Model ID Mapping**: Constants define valid model IDs for content types

# Plan: Prevent duplicate Fragment Title for cloned cards in M@S Studio

## Summary
When a card is cloned in M@S Studio, the clone dialog pre-populates the title with the
original fragment's title, allowing two cards to share the same Fragment Title under the
same tag path. This adds a `generateUniqueTitle` utility and wires it into the clone flow
so the dialog always defaults to a deduplicated title — while still allowing manual overrides.

## Task Description
Introduce uniqueness checking for Fragment Title when a card is cloned. Before the clone
dialog opens, check whether any fragment in the current loaded list shares the same title
as the source fragment. If a conflict exists, append a numeric suffix (`-1`, `-2`, etc.)
to produce a unique default title. Uniqueness is implicitly scoped to the current tag path
because `Store.fragments.list.data` already holds only fragments matching the active search
context. Manual edits in the dialog are never blocked.

## Relevant Files

| File | Action | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `studio/src/utils.js` | Edit | Add `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` utility |
| `studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js` | Edit | Call `generateUniqueTitle` in `showClone()` to pre-populate `titleClone`; bind `titleClone` in clone dialog textfield |

## Step by Step Tasks

### 1. Add `generateUniqueTitle` to `studio/src/utils.js`

- Export a new function `generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles)` where `existingTitles` is a `Set` or array of strings.
- If `baseTitle` is not in `existingTitles`, return it unchanged.
- Otherwise, strip any trailing `-N` numeric suffix from `baseTitle` to get the root base string (regex: `/-\d+$/`).
- Loop from `n = 1` upward, testing `${base}-${n}` until one is not in `existingTitles`.
- Return the first available candidate.

```js
export function generateUniqueTitle(baseTitle, existingTitles) {
    const titles = new Set(existingTitles);
    if (!titles.has(baseTitle)) return baseTitle;
    const base = baseTitle.replace(/-\d+$/, '');
    let n = 1;
    let candidate;
    do {
        candidate = `${base}-${n++}`;
    } while (titles.has(candidate));
    return candidate;
}
```

### 2. Import and call `generateUniqueTitle` in `showClone()` (`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`)

- Import `generateUniqueTitle` from `./utils.js` at the top of the file.
- In `showClone()` (line ~1088), after the discard-changes guard, compute the list of existing titles from `Store.fragments.list.data.get()`:
  ```js
  const existingTitles = Store.fragments.list.data
      .get()
      .map((s) => s.get()?.title)
      .filter(Boolean);
  this.titleClone = generateUniqueTitle(this.fragment.title, existingTitles);
  ```
- This sets `titleClone` to a unique value before the dialog renders.
- Also reset `titleClone` in `cancelClone()` to `''` (already done at line ~1123-1128; ensure it is reset there).

### 3. Bind `titleClone` in the clone dialog textfield (`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`)

- In the clone dialog render (line ~1251), change the textfield `value` attribute from:
  ```js
  value="${this.fragment.title}"
  ```
  to:
  ```js
  value="${this.titleClone}"
  ```
- This ensures the dialog opens showing the deduplicated title. User can still type a different title, which updates `titleClone` via the existing `updateCloneFragmentInternal` handler.

### 4. Pass `titleClone` correctly in `confirmClone()` (`studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`)

- `confirmClone()` already calls `this.repository.copyFragment(this.titleClone, ...)`.
- With `titleClone` now always set in `showClone()`, the title passed to `copyFragment` will be the unique (or manually edited) title.
- No change needed in `copyFragment` itself.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Cloning a card whose title already exists in the current list produces a default dialog title with `-1` suffix
- Cloning again produces `-2`, `-3`, etc. in sequence
- The original card's title is unchanged after any clone operation
- If the user manually types a custom title in the clone dialog, that custom value is used verbatim (no auto-dedup on manual edits)
- Uniqueness check is based on fragments already loaded in `Store.fragments.list.data` (same tag path scope)
- No two cards in the current list share the same Fragment Title after a clone operation

## Validation Commands
- `node --check studio/src/utils.js`
- `node --check studio/src/mas-fragment-editor.js`
